title: Desktop Technician
description:
Desktop Technician
Carmel, IN (Onsite)
12-Month Contract
Job ID 25-09829

Solugenix is assisting a client, a prestigious and large investment management company, in their search for a Desktop Technician. This is a 12-month contract opportunity based out of Carmel, IN (Onsite).

Under direct supervision, the Desktop Technician provides virtual and/or in-person end-user support for the client's technology platforms. This role is vital to the efficient operation of technology systems, with a focus on delivering effective, efficient, and proactive support. The Desktop Technician is responsible, with limited assistance, for analyzing, diagnosing, and resolving technology issues using their knowledge base, dashboards, proactive alerts, reporting tools, and ticket assignment systems. Unresolved issues are escalated to senior team members, and the technician participates in ongoing efforts to improve troubleshooting processes and service efficiency. This role also has a heavy emphasis on the full lifecycle of Hardware Asset Management.

Qualifications:

  • Requires 4-6 years of relevant experience in desktop support or a related IT field.
  • Proficient in ServiceNow for incident management, ticketing, workflow tracking, and hardware asset management.
  • Technical knowledge of both PC and Mac environments, including operating systems and hardware components.
  • Ability to support, troubleshoot, and resolve issues for Windows and macOS platforms, as well as common software applications.
  • Strong understanding of LAN/WAN connectivity and networking basics.
Responsibilities:
  • Maintain, analyze, troubleshoot, and repair computer systems, hardware, and computer peripherals.
  • Document, maintain, upgrade, or replace hardware and software systems as needed.
  • Support, monitor, test, and troubleshoot hardware and software issues related to LAN/WAN connectivity and operating systems.
  • Provide end-user support for all LAN-based applications, both remotely and in person.
  • Build, prepare, and distribute computer equipment for new hire associates and contractors.
  • Process and scan returned computer equipment from departed associates and contractors.
  • Recommend and schedule repairs for equipment as necessary.
  • Adhere to all equipment deployment procedures, maintaining accurate records in the inventory tracking system and ensuring compliance with asset management policies throughout all lifecycle stages.
  • In coordination with the support team, perform general preventative maintenance on desktop PCs, laptops, printers, and other authorized hardware.
  • Install and configure workstations for end users.
Communication & Interpersonal Skills:
  • Excellent communicator in all forms (verbal, written, digital) with the ability to provide clear updates to team members and managers.
  • Strong verbal communication skills, including the ability to actively listen and articulate technical solutions clearly and concisely.
  • Ability to maintain a professional and empathetic tone when interacting with end users and colleagues.
Physical Requirements:
  • Physical ability to lift boxes of laptops and other computer hardware as required for equipment deployment and maintenance.

Pay Range for CA, CO, IL, NJ, NY, WA, and DC: $37.93/hour to $37.93/hour. Starting rate of pay offered may vary depending on factors including but not limited to, position offered, location, education, training, and/or experience.

Solugenix will consider qualified applicants with a criminal history pursuant to the California Fair Chance Act and Ordinance. Applicants do not need to disclose their criminal history or participate in a background check until a conditional job offer is made to you. After making a conditional offer and running a background check, if we are concerned about conviction that is directly related to the job, applicants will be given the chance to explain the circumstances surrounding the conviction, provide mitigating evidence, or challenge the accuracy of the background report.

title: Corporate Social Responsibility Program Coordinator
description:
Corporate Social Responsibility Program Coordinator
Los Angeles, CA (Hybrid)
2-Month Contract
Job ID 25-09825

Solugenix is assisting a client, a prestigious and large investment management company, in their search for a Corporate Social Responsibility Program Coordinator. This is a 2-month contract opportunity based out of Los Angeles, CA (Hybrid).

The client's spirit of philanthropy and caring for people and our communities has pervaded our culture since our founding over 90 years ago. In the last few years, we've centralized and accelerated our investment in this work under the Sustainability & Social Responsibility (SSR) function. Our commitment to SSR is organized around 3 pillars:
1) Capital Cares: Our associate-driven charitable giving and volunteering programs.
2) Social Impact: Our strategic philanthropy program focused on enabling more families to benefit from the transformational impacts of wealth accumulation.
3) Environmental Stewardship: Our efforts to reduce the environmental impact of our corporate operations and provide transparency to stakeholders through sustainability reporting.
The SSR Associate primarily supports the Capital Cares pillar of the SSR team's work, but at times may also support the Social Impact and Environmental Stewardship Pillars.

Qualifications:

  • Passion for community engagement through charitable giving, economic inclusion and environmental sustainability.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Effective communicator.
  • Ability to effectively work with and balance the needs of multiple stakeholders at all levels of the organization and across various business units.
  • Ability to work independently in support of a larger team project, and also collaboratively with team members to align to wider strategy.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects at once.
  • Previous experience with nonprofits through volunteering or work experience and/or SSR programs a plus.
Responsibilities:
Capital Cares Program Administration:
  • Review and approve associate matching gift requests.
  • Support the Associate Involvement Grant Program.
  • Initiate and facilitate the grant request process.
  • Review grant applications.
  • Approve grant amounts and schedule payments.
  • Monitor Capital Cares email inbox and answer associates' and nonprofits' questions.
  • Support the onboarding of new nonprofits into our charitable giving system.
  • Support management of local Capital Cares Committees including scheduling meetings, preparing meeting materials, and circulating meeting notes.
  • Support planning and execution of volunteering trips and activities.
  • Support delivery of Capital Cares programs participation data dashboards.
Social Impact:
  • Support research, management, and delivery of social impact programs focused on youth, community leaders, small businesses, and financial advisors.
  • Support social impact grant-making activities including reviewing nonprofit applications, categorizing and tagging opportunities by region and community focus, processing grant agreements, scheduling payments, and supporting local Capital Cares Committee and DE&I Community engagement with the Social Impact program.
  • Support project management for multi-year partnerships with non-profit organizations.
  • Support associates' volunteering activities related to the client's financial education curriculum.
Environmental Stewardship:
  • Support annual Sustainability reporting efforts.
  • Support GHG emissions reporting and data collection.
  • Support regulatory compliance related to corporate sustainability reporting.
Other/Special Projects:
  • Create meeting materials for SSR governing committee meetings and SSR leadership.
  • Work on special projects, as needed.
  • Performs additional responsibilities as assigned.

Santiago, Dominican Republic (Onsite)

Summary
Accountable to provide technical support to a dedicated customer base. Seeks to resolve computer software and hardware issues while ensuring customer satisfaction.

Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out written or verbal instructions. Ability to deal with problems involving concrete variables in standardized situations. Ability to solve practical problems via a logical, analytic approach.

Ability to multi-task. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment. Strong time management and organizational skills.

  • Type 35+ words per minute.
